limitations: Infrastructure is historical OSM from 27 July 2026; missing/unmapped assets are not counted.
Copernicus Sentinel Hub processed raw GRD with Copernicus DEM30; API orchestration remains manual for this run.
Gamma0 terrain threshold is uncalibrated; exposure is to water candidates, not confirmed flood damage.
EMSR927 damage labels were not used for prediction or threshold selection.
Historical road topology acquired; inferred disruption assumes every exposed road segment is unusable.
Nearest-node settlement/hospital snapping is a proximity assumption, not verified driveway access.
Network components touching extract edges are boundary-uncertain. Unobserved roads remain unknown, not open.
Turn restrictions and time-dependent access restrictions are not modelled.

Candidate vegetation loss to bare ground with SAR change; can confuse land clearing/agriculture and misses debris on already bare ground. Not trained or independently calibrated. Optical SCL is native 20m resampled to 10m.
